leaf_semantics.quote_f2: how to derive the optimal per-champion rotation from atomized data. Define the scoring: for each champion, rank its damaging abilities by (a) DPS contribution per rank at the fight's stats, (b) setup/consume relationships (e.g. Cassiopeia Q poisons BEFORE E spam; Varus Q detonates Blight applied by autos/W ...), (c) cooldown gating (cast order must respect cooldowns), (d) buffs first
leaf_semantics.quote_f3: DETECT setup/consume edges automatically from the ability rows + module metadata: an ability whose row names indicate application (poison/blemish/stack/mark/amp/slow/root/stun/on-hit) must precede abilities that consume (enhanced/consume/detonate/bonus-vs/X-stack/%missing)
leaf_semantics.reading: `setup` is the applier side of a setup/consume edge — the ability that must be cast first because later casts consume what it applies. setup[0] is therefore the ability Syndra's other casts depend on, not merely the ability that carries crowd control.

signal_a_setup_consume_edges.quote_Q: Active: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds. (data/champions.json Syndra.abilities.Q[0].effects[0].description)

consumers.quote: Active: Syndra telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere, enemy minion or non-epic monster within 500 units from the target location ... She prioritizes grabbing the nearest unit, then Dark Spheres. (Syndra.abilities.W[0].effects[0].description)
consumers.consequence: Enemy champions are not grabbable. In a champion-only coupled fight W has no throwable object unless a Dark Sphere already exists, so W's rank-5 recast damage (190 + 65% AP) is 0 without a preceding Q.

consumers.quote: Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units and up to 1200 units away from Syndra based on proximity, knocking back enemies they hit over 70 units ... Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds, during which they are also revealed, and dealt Scatter the Weak's damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast. (Syndra.abilities.E[0].effects[1].description)
consumers.consequence: E's stun (and the sphere-carried instance of its damage) exists only when a Dark Sphere is already on the ground — i.e. only after Q.

consumers.quote: Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit. (Syndra.abilities.R[0].effects[1].description)
consumers.leveling_rows: Magic Damage per Sphere 80/120/160 (+20% AP); Minimum Magic Damage 240/360/480 (+60% AP) = 3 spheres; Maximum Magic Damage 560/840/1120 (+140% AP) = 7 spheres
consumers.consequence: The 4 extra spheres are 'live ones' produced by Q (6 s sphere lifetime). At rank 1 / 0 AP, R with Q setup = 560 vs 240 without = 2.333x.

signal_a_setup_consume_edges.reverse_edge_check: No Syndra ability has a leveling row or effect row conditioned on a stunned/knocked-back/slowed target. Q's only row is 'Magic Damage'; W's rows are 'Magic Damage' and the 60-splinter 'Bonus True Damage' (gated on Splinters of Wrath, not on E); E's only row is 'Magic Damage'; R's rows are gated on sphere count. Nothing in the kit consumes E's stun/knockback/slow, so E is not the applier of any setup/consume edge — it is a consumer of Q's spheres.
signal_a_setup_consume_edges.timing_check: Q's sphere 'appears after a 0.6-second delay'; E's castTime is 0.25 s (data/champions.json). Casting E before Q therefore cannot knock a sphere: the sphere does not yet exist when the cone passes. Q must lead E by at least 0.6 s for the stun to occur — the edge is directional and cannot be satisfied with E first.
signal_a_setup_consume_edges.conclusion: The unique applier in Syndra's kit is Q. setup = [Q]; setup[0] = Q.

signal_b_per_rank_dps_tiebreak.formula: raw_total / effective_cooldown (F2 signal (a)/F3 1b), rank 5 (R rank 3) values from data/champions.json
signal_b_per_rank_dps_tiebreak.cooldowns_quoted: Q rechargeRate 7/7/7/7/7 (affectedByCdr false; R passive: 'Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of ability haste'); W 12/11/10/9/8 (CDR yes); E 15/15/15/15/15 (CDR yes); R 120/100/80
signal_b_per_rank_dps_tiebreak.conclusion: Q is the highest-throughput cast at every AP level tested and E is the lowest, so even the DPS tiebreak — which only applies to abilities left over after the edges are honoured — never promotes E ahead of Q.

independent_computation.signal_c_cooldown_gating: Q is the shortest-cycle cast (7 s recharge, plus a second stocked charge at 40 Splinters of Wrath — the module's synthetic Q2 slot per data/champion-audit/batch-6.json). Cooldown gating also favours Q leading and recurring; E at a flat 15 s is the least frequently castable non-ultimate.
independent_computation.why_E_first_is_wrong: E carries the crowd control (1.25 s stun; 70% slow at 80 Splinters), so a keyword-only detector that reads 'stun/slow' as an application marker would classify E as setup. But the setup/consume rule requires a consumer on the other end of the edge, and no Syndra row consumes crowd control. Ordering E first also inverts the only real edge in the kit: with E at setup[0] the cone deals its 200 (+60% AP) with no stun, W has nothing to throw, and R fires at its 3-sphere minimum instead of up to 7.
